tasks.title: Initial project charter and scope definition
tasks.description: Define project objectives, boundaries, team structure, and key milestones for the green methanol project
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Charter signed by sponsor

tasks.title: Green methanol market study and offtake assessment
tasks.description: Analyse marine fuel, chemical feedstock, and blending markets for green methanol; identify potential offtakers and pricing
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Identifies 3+ potential offtakers with volume estimates

tasks.title: Feedstock availability and supply assessment
tasks.description: Survey regional agricultural residue, forestry residue, and organic waste availability; assess seasonality, logistics, and pricing
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Quantifies minimum 3 feedstock sources with 5-year supply curve

tasks.title: Preliminary mass balance and carbon intensity estimate
tasks.description: Calculate high-level material flows (biomass → methanol) and carbon intensity using LCA methodology
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Estimates within ±50% of preliminary design

tasks.title: Technology landscape review
tasks.description: Survey gasifier vendors (fixed bed, fluidised bed, entrained flow), syngas cleanup licensors, and methanol synthesis licensors
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Evaluates 5+ technology options with pros/cons

tasks.title: Partner and JV strategy
tasks.description: Identify potential partners for feedstock supply, technology licensing, offtake, and project finance
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Shortlist of 3+ potential partners

tasks.title: High-level CAPEX/OPEX estimate (±50%)
tasks.description: Develop order-of-magnitude cost estimate based on benchmark data from similar biomass-to-methanol projects
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Estimate within ±50% of expected final cost

tasks.title: Preliminary project schedule
tasks.description: Develop high-level milestone schedule from Phase 1 through Phase 7
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Schedule covers all 8 phases with gate dates

tasks.title: Detailed feedstock supply study
tasks.description: Comprehensive assessment of feedstock sources: type, volume, seasonal variation, logistics route, cost curve, contract structure
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Covers 5-year supply with monthly granularity

tasks.title: Biomass characterisation testing
tasks.description: Ultimate and proximate analysis of candidate feedstocks: moisture, ash, volatiles, C/H/O/N/S, alkali metals, chlorine
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All major feedstocks tested per ASTM standards

tasks.title: Site selection study
tasks.description: Evaluate 3+ candidate sites against feedstock proximity, water, power, grid, port access, land cost, community impact
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Ranked shortlist with preferred site recommendation

tasks.title: Environmental baseline study
tasks.description: Air quality, water quality, noise, ecology, soil studies at candidate sites to establish pre-project baseline
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All baseline parameters measured per regulatory guidelines

tasks.title: Feedstock handling and storage concept design
tasks.description: Conceptual design for biomass receiving, covered storage, drying system (if needed), sizing, blending, and conveying to gasifier
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Layout selected for at least 7 days storage capacity

tasks.title: Feedstock supply agreement heads of terms
tasks.description: Negotiate heads of terms with major feedstock suppliers covering volume, quality, price, duration, force majeure
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Covers 70%+ of annual feedstock requirement

tasks.title: Technology pre-screening and shortlisting
tasks.description: Evaluate gasifier, syngas cleanup, and methanol synthesis licensors against project requirements; shortlist 2-3 per technology
tasks.acceptance_criteria: At least 2 qualified vendors per technology

tasks.title: Preliminary plot plan and layout
tasks.description: Develop block plot plan showing gasification island, syngas cleanup, methanol synthesis, distillation, storage, utilities, flare
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All major process areas located with access and laydown

tasks.title: Gasifier technology selection
tasks.description: Select gasifier type (fixed bed, fluidised bed, entrained flow) and oxidant (air, oxygen, steam, oxygen-steam) based on feedstock and scale
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Technology selected with licensor LOI

tasks.title: Oxidant selection and air separation assessment
tasks.description: Evaluate air-blown vs oxygen-blown configuration; if oxygen selected, assess ASU vs third-party supply options
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Configuration decision and supply route defined

tasks.title: Syngas cleanup technology selection
tasks.description: Select tar removal (reformer, scrubber, or catalytic cracker), particulate filter, acid gas removal, and guard bed configuration
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Technology selected with target output specs (tar, S, Cl, metals)

tasks.title: Methanol synthesis reactor selection
tasks.description: Select reactor type: boiling water reactor, multi-bed quench, or isothermal; identify preferred licensor
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Reactor type and licensor selected

tasks.title: Distillation configuration study
tasks.description: Select two-column vs three-column distillation scheme, define product purity targets (IMPCA spec)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Configuration selected with heat integration plan

tasks.title: Process simulation and mass/energy balance
tasks.description: Develop full process simulation in Aspen Plus or equivalent; calculate material balance, energy balance, and utility requirements
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Mass balance closure within 1%; energy balance validated

tasks.title: Preliminary P&IDs and heat integration
tasks.description: Develop preliminary P&IDs for major process blocks; identify heat integration opportunities (steam generation, preheat trains)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All major process blocks covered

tasks.title: Utility requirements study
tasks.description: Define power, steam, cooling water, nitrogen, instrument air, and demin water requirements for the facility
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All utility demands quantified for FEED basis

tasks.title: CAPEX estimate ±30%
tasks.description: Develop factored CAPEX estimate based on equipment list from process simulation and vendor budgetary quotes
tasks.acceptance_criteria: NCCS Class 3 estimate methodology followed

tasks.title: OPEX estimate and cost of production model
tasks.description: Develop OPEX model including feedstock, utilities, catalyst/chemicals, labour, maintenance, and overhead
tasks.acceptance_criteria: CoP estimate per tonne methanol

tasks.title: Technology licensor negotiation and license agreement
tasks.description: Negotiate technology license terms, fees, performance guarantees, and support scope with selected licensors
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All major technology licenses signed

tasks.title: EPC contracting strategy
tasks.description: Define EPC contract type (lump-sum turnkey, reimbursable, EPCM), preparation of bid list, and contracting plan
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Approved by project board

tasks.title: Feasibility study report
tasks.description: Compile all Phase 2 work into a comprehensive feasibility study for investment decision
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Reviewed and approved by investment committee

tasks.title: Front-end engineering design (FEED) kick-off
tasks.description: Mobilise FEED team, issue design basis, develop FEED schedule and budget
tasks.acceptance_criteria: FEED team mobilised

tasks.title: Detailed P&ID development
tasks.description: Develop P&IDs to IFD (Issue for Design) level for all process blocks: feedstock handling, gasification, syngas cleanup, methanol synthesis, distillation, utilities
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All P&IDs issued for design review

tasks.title: Plot plan and 3D model development
tasks.description: Develop detailed plot plan and initial 3D model for equipment layout, piping routing, and access
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All major equipment located in model

tasks.title: HAZID study
tasks.description: Conduct Hazard Identification study across all process blocks to identify major hazards and risk scenarios
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All hazard scenarios identified and risk-ranked

tasks.title: HAZOP study
tasks.description: Conduct Hazard and Operability study on P&IDs for all process blocks; document deviations, causes, consequences, and recommendations
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All HAZOP nodes completed; recommendations assigned and tracked

tasks.title: Quantitative risk assessment (QRA)
tasks.description: Model major accident scenarios (gasifier rupture, methanol release, syngas leak, hydrogen storage) and quantify risk contours
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Risk contours within acceptable criteria per regulatory guidance

tasks.title: Environmental impact assessment (EIA)
tasks.description: Full EIA covering air emissions, wastewater, solid waste, ecology, socio-economic impact; public consultation if required
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Submitted to regulatory authority

tasks.title: Environmental clearance application
tasks.description: Prepare and submit environmental clearance application to regulatory authority with EIA report
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Application acknowledged by regulatory authority

tasks.title: Hazardous chemicals and methanol storage permits
tasks.description: Apply for permits related to storage of hazardous chemicals, specifically methanol and syngas, under relevant regulations
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Applications submitted with all required documentation

tasks.title: Fire safety approval application
tasks.description: Prepare and submit fire safety approval application including fire protection philosophy, water demand, and layout compliance
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Approved by fire authority

tasks.title: Factory licence application
tasks.description: Prepare factory licence application under applicable factory acts
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Application submitted

tasks.title: Land acquisition and zoning clearance
tasks.description: Complete land acquisition, verify zoning compliance, obtain change of land use if needed
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Land registered and zoned for industrial use

tasks.title: EPC tender package preparation
tasks.description: Prepare EPC tender documents including scope of work, technical specifications, commercial terms, and bid evaluation criteria
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tender package approved for issue

tasks.title: Long-lead equipment ordering
tasks.description: Issue purchase orders for long-lead equipment: gasifier, syngas compressor, methanol reactor, distillation columns
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Orders placed with agreed delivery schedule

tasks.title: Offtake agreement negotiation and execution
tasks.description: Negotiate and execute binding offtake agreement for green methanol with identified buyers
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Binding offtake for 50%+ of nameplate capacity

tasks.title: Financing close
tasks.description: Finalise project financing including debt facilities, equity commitments, and financial close
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All financing agreements executed

tasks.title: Investment decision gate (FID)
tasks.description: Present project to investment committee with FEED, permits, financing, and offtake; secure final investment decision
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Positive investment decision and budget release

tasks.title: EPC contract award
tasks.description: Evaluate EPC bids, negotiate contract terms, and award EPC contract
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Contract awarded within approved budget

tasks.title: Detailed engineering (IFC deliverables)
tasks.description: Develop issue-for-construction drawings including P&IDs, isometrics, structural, electrical, and instrument drawings
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All disciplines complete for construction

tasks.title: Biomass handling system procurement
tasks.description: Procure biomass receiving, storage, drying, sizing, and conveying equipment
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All equipment ordered with delivery milestones

tasks.title: Gasifier and syngashandling equipment procurement
tasks.description: Procure gasifier, syngas cooler, cyclones, and other gasifier island equipment
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Gasifier and auxiliaries ordered with delivery schedule

tasks.title: Syngas cleanup system procurement
tasks.description: Procure tar reformer/cracker, particulate filter, scrubber, acid gas removal, and guard bed vessels
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All cleanup equipment ordered with delivery milestones

tasks.title: Methanol synthesis reactor and distillation procurement
tasks.description: Procure methanol synthesis reactor, heat exchangers, distillation columns, reboilers, condensers
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All major process packages under purchase order

tasks.title: Civil works: foundations and site preparation
tasks.description: Site grading, piling, concrete foundations for all major equipment, buildings, roads, and drainage
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All foundations poured and cured per spec

tasks.title: Structural steel fabrication and erection
tasks.description: Fabricate and erect structural steel for pipe racks, equipment platforms, building structures, and flare tower
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All steel erected and inspected per code

tasks.title: Equipment setting and alignment
tasks.description: Receive, set, and align all major equipment: gasifier, vessels, columns, compressors, heat exchangers, pumps
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All equipment set and rough-aligned

tasks.title: Piping fabrication and erection
tasks.description: Fabricate and erect process, utility, and instrument piping; install valves, fittings, and specialty items
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All piping installed per IFC drawings

tasks.title: Electrical and instrumentation installation
tasks.description: Install cables, panels, motor control centres, VFDs, instruments, analysers, and control system hardware
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All cables pulled and terminated

tasks.title: Catalyst procurement and storage
tasks.description: Procure methanol synthesis catalyst (Cu/ZnO/Al2O3) and catalyst protection materials; ensure proper storage conditions
tasks.deliverables: Catalyst purchase order and storage plan
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Catalyst ordered with delivery 4 weeks before loading

tasks.title: Pre-commissioning procedure preparation
tasks.description: Prepare pre-commissioning and commissioning procedures for all process systems
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All procedures reviewed and approved

tasks.title: Quality assurance inspections
tasks.description: Conduct QA inspections during fabrication and construction: welding NDT, concrete testing, pressure test witness, coating inspection
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All inspection records documented per ITP

tasks.title: Progress monitoring and reporting
tasks.description: Develop and maintain project controls: ETC, earned value, S-curves, progress % complete, change log, risk register updates
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Reports issued within 5 days of month close

tasks.title: Change order management
tasks.description: Process change orders: technical review, cost/schedule impact assessment, approval, implementation tracking
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All changes processed within 14 days of identification

tasks.title: Mechanical completion checks per system
tasks.description: Verify each system is mechanically complete: all equipment installed, piping connected, instruments loop-checked
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All systems signed off by commissioning manager

tasks.title: Punch list resolution
tasks.description: Document, prioritise, and resolve construction punch list items before commissioning start
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Open punch items < 10% of total

tasks.title: Piping hydrotest, flushing, and chemical cleaning
tasks.description: Hydrostatically test all process piping; flush with water or chemical clean as required per system criticality
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All systems tested per piping code

tasks.title: Instrument loop checks
tasks.description: Verify all instrument loops: sensor → DCS indication, control valve stroke test, analyser calibration
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All loops checked and documented

tasks.title: Electrical megger checks and motor run-in
tasks.description: Megger all motor feeders, perform motor solo run tests, check rotation direction and vibration
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All motors operate correctly uncoupled

tasks.title: Control system (DCS/SCADA) checkout
tasks.description: Check DCS/SCADA configuration, interlock logic, alarm setpoints, control loop tuning, and operator interface
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All interlocks verified, alarms tested

tasks.title: Refractory dry-out for gasifier
tasks.description: Perform controlled refractory dry-out per manufacturer specification; monitor temperature gradient and moisture evolution
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Refractory cured per manufacturer spec

tasks.title: Catalyst loading (methanol synthesis reactor)
tasks.description: Load Cu/ZnO/Al2O3 catalyst into methanol synthesis reactor per licensor procedure; verify bed levels and pressure drop
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Catalyst loaded per licensor procedure

tasks.title: Dry-run of biomass handling system
tasks.description: Operate biomass handling system with inert material (sawdust or wood chips) to verify conveyors, screens, magnets, and feeding
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Handling system operates at design rate for 4 hours

tasks.title: Safety system function tests (ESD, fire & gas)
tasks.description: Test emergency shutdown system, fire and gas detection, deluge/ sprinkler, and alarm system per approved test script
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All safety functions verified

tasks.title: Flare system check and purging
tasks.description: Verify flare system integrity: KO drum, seal drum, purge gas rate, pilot ignition, and radiation contours
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Flare operational with reliable pilot

tasks.title: Pre-start-up safety review (PSSR)
tasks.description: Conduct PSSR walkthrough per system; verify all HAZOP recommendations resolved, safety systems operational, and procedures in place
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All HAZOP recommendations closed; PSSR team recommends start-up

tasks.title: Operations team training and certification
tasks.description: Train operations and maintenance teams on plant systems, SOPs, safety procedures, and emergency response
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All operators certified for their shift role

tasks.title: Biomass feeding trials
tasks.description: Graduated feeding trials from 10% to 100% design rate; monitor feeder reliability, bridging, and material flow
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Sustained feeding at 100% design rate for 4 hours

tasks.title: Gasifier light-up and refractory heat-up
tasks.description: Light gasifier pilot burners, gradually increase temperature to gasification range; monitor refractory, heat profile, and emissions
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Stable gasification temperature achieved

tasks.title: Syngas production ramping
tasks.description: Increase biomass feed rate to design condition; monitor syngas composition (CO, H2, CO2, CH4), tar content, and temperature profile
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Design syngas flow and composition within spec

tasks.title: Syngas cleanup system validation
tasks.description: Verify tar removal, particulate filtration, H2S/COS removal, HCl removal, and guard bed performance at design conditions
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Output syngas meets methanol synthesis inlet spec (tar < 50 mg/Nm3, S < 0.1 ppmv, Cl < 1 ppmv)

tasks.title: Methanol synthesis loop start-up
tasks.description: Catalyst reduction, loop pressurisation, syngas introduction, methanol formation, and recycle loop establishment
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Stable methanol production at 50%+ design rate

tasks.title: Crude methanol production and analysis
tasks.description: Collect crude methanol samples; analyse for water, ethanol, higher alcohols, and impurities
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Crude composition within expected range for distillation

tasks.title: Distillation start-up and product quality adjustment
tasks.description: Start distillation columns, establish reflux, adjust operating parameters to achieve IMPCA-grade methanol
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Product meets IMPCA spec (min 99.85 wt% methanol)

tasks.title: Product methanol loading to storage
tasks.description: Transfer on-spec product to methanol storage tanks; verify tank blanketing, level instrumentation, and loading system
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Product accepted into storage

tasks.title: Performance guarantee test run
tasks.description: 72-100 hour continuous run at nameplate capacity under design conditions; monitor all performance parameters per guarantee
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All performance guarantees met (capacity, consumption, quality, emissions)

tasks.title: Emissions compliance testing
tasks.description: Measure stack emissions, fugitive emissions, wastewater quality, and noise levels; compare with permit conditions
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All measured parameters within permit limits

tasks.title: By-product management verification
tasks.description: Validate ash/char handling, wastewater treatment, off-gas treatment (flare/thermal oxidiser), and any solid waste streams
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All waste streams managed per regulatory requirement

tasks.title: Interim acceptance certificate (IAC)
tasks.description: Prepare and negotiate interim acceptance certificate with EPC contractor; document exceptions and punch list
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Certificate signed by owner and contractor

tasks.title: Operations and maintenance manual handover
tasks.description: Compile and hand over O&M manuals, equipment data sheets, vendor manuals, lubrication schedules, and inspection plans
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All manuals reviewed and accepted by operations team

tasks.title: Spare parts inventory and warehouse transfer
tasks.description: Inventory all spare parts, consumables, and consumables; transfer to operations warehouse with inventory management system
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Inventory reconciled with procurement list

tasks.title: Reliability and availability tracking
tasks.description: Establish reliability tracking system; begin logging equipment runtime, failures, downtime for guarantee period
tasks.acceptance_criteria: System operational with baseline data

tasks.title: Catalyst performance monitoring
tasks.description: Monitor methanol synthesis catalyst performance: conversion per pass, pressure drop, temperature profile, by-product formation
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Baseline established at design conditions

tasks.title: Feedstock optimisation plan
tasks.description: Develop feedstock blending and moisture management strategy to optimise gasifier performance and methanol yield
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Plan approved by operations manager

tasks.title: Syngas ratio fine-tuning
tasks.description: Optimise H2/CO/CO2 ratio through WGS bypass, CO2 removal/recycle, and/or H2 addition for maximum methanol yield
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Stoichiometric number (SN) maintained at 2.0 ± 0.1

tasks.title: Energy efficiency improvement program
tasks.description: Identify and implement energy-saving measures: heat recovery, steam management, insulation upgrades, process optimisation
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Energy consumption within 5% of design target

tasks.title: Environmental compliance reporting
tasks.description: Submit first periodic environmental compliance report; establish ongoing monitoring and reporting cadence
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Report accepted by regulatory authority

tasks.title: Operator training completion for steady-state operations
tasks.description: Complete operator training on normal operations, start-up, shutdown, emergency response, and troubleshooting
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All operators assessed as competent

tasks.title: Final acceptance certificate (FAC)
tasks.description: Prepare and negotiate final acceptance certificate with EPC contractor; close all exceptions and punch list items
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Certificate signed; warranty period begins

tasks.title: Lessons learned report
tasks.description: Compile lessons learned across all phases: technical, commercial, project management, and organisational
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Report reviewed with management

tasks.title: Continuous improvement program launch
tasks.description: Establish continuous improvement framework with KPIs, targets, review cadence, and improvement project pipeline
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Program approved and launched

tasks.title: Define IMPCA Methanol Specification Compliance Targets
tasks.description: Document the IMPCA (International Methanol Producers and Consumers Association) methanol specification requirements including purity (min 99.85 wt%), water content, ethanol, acetone, and other impurities; map to process design targets
tasks.deliverables: IMPCA spec compliance matrix; process parameter targets for each impurity
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All IMPCA parameters mapped to process design or distillation specifications

tasks.title: Establish Methanol Quality Control Lab & Test Procedures
tasks.description: Set up on-site or contracted quality control laboratory with ASTM/ISO test methods for methanol purity, water content (Karl Fischer), ethanol (GC), acidity, color, and density; define sampling frequency and chain-of-custody
tasks.deliverables: QC lab setup checklist; test procedure manual; sampling schedule; COA template
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Lab equipped and calibrated; all test methods validated; QC team trained on procedures

tasks.title: Develop Product Certification & Chain-of-Custody Documentation (ISCC / RSB)
tasks.description: Prepare documentation for green methanol sustainability certification under ISCC EU or RSB — including mass balance, greenhouse gas calculation, chain-of-custody audit trail, and feedstock sustainability declaration
tasks.deliverables: Certification evidence package; GHG calculation model; mass balance documentation system
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Certification body pre-audit passes; evidence package complete for formal audit

tasks.title: Conduct Methanol Product Quality Validation During Commissioning
tasks.description: During commissioning runs, sample and test crude and fuel-grade methanol at each distillation stage; verify IMPCA spec compliance across full operating range; document batch certificate of analysis
tasks.deliverables: Commissioning COA batch records; spec compliance report for the performance test run
tasks.acceptance_criteria: First product batch meets all IMPCA specification parameters; COA issued for commercial sales

tasks.title: Establish Ongoing Product Quality Monitoring & Steady-State Certification
tasks.description: Set up routine quality monitoring programme — daily QC checks, weekly full analysis, monthly certification body reporting; maintain chain-of-custody records for sustainability certification renewals
tasks.deliverables: Quality monitoring SOP; daily/weekly/monthly test schedule; sustainability certification renewal calendar
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Quality monitoring plan accepted by operations; certification renewal cycle established
